data.name: Khawla
data.gender_notes: Khawla is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Khawla means 'companion' or 'friend'. It is a feminine given name that symbolizes a strong bond of friendship and companionship. The name Khawla carries the meaning “Companion, Friend” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Khawla usually hope their child will grow to embody companion, friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Khawla belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion, Friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khawla total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_english.name: Khawla
in_english.meaning: beloved of kings and those with pure intentions
in_english.long_meaning: Khawla is an Arabic name that means beloved of kings and those with pure intentions. It is a name steeped in Islamic tradition and is considered a name of great honor. In Arabic, the name Khawla is derived from the root kh-w-l, which means to love or be fond of. The name is often associated with the qualities of loyalty, devotion, and purity. In Islamic tradition, Khawla is considered a name that is pleasing to Allah and is often given to girls born into noble or royal families.
